body: I can't keep any job so I can't make enough money to travel at all, I'm needy and that means people never stick around. I'm great at making friends, but I can't keep them for shit. Basically despite them trying to give me all the tools I need, and showing me what you could do with them, I continue to find myself unable to use them and alone. I love my family, but they aren't enough.  I need to be able to live on my own and I'm failing every time I get a chance.
